mapper.insert: INSERT INTO int_integration_task ( task_code, task_name, task_type, enabled, active_revision_id, draft_revision_id, config_version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{taskCode}, #{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{enabled}, #{activeRevisionId}, #{draftRevisionId}, #{configVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO int_integration_task_revision ( revision_id, task_code, revision_no, status, config_json, config_checksum, dependency_revisions_json, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{revisionId}, #{taskCode}, #{revisionNo}, #{status}, #{configJson}, #{checksum}, #{dependencyRevisionsJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO int_integration_task_revision ( task_code, revision_no, status, config_json, config_checksum, dependency_revisions_json, validation_json, change_note, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{taskCode}, #{revisionNo}, #{status}, #{configJson}, #{checksum}, #{dependencyRevisionsJson}, #{validationJson}, #{changeNote}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE int_integration_task_revision SET status = #{status}, config_json = #{configJson}, config_checksum = #{checksum}, dependency_revisions_json = #{dependencyRevisionsJson}, validation_json = NULL, change_note = #{changeNote}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'VALIDATED')

UPDATE int_integration_task_revision SET status = 'VALIDATED', validation_json = #{validationJson}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'VALIDATED')
UPDATE int_integration_task_revision SET status = 'ARCHIVED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE int_integration_task_revision SET status = 'PUBLISHED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status = 'VALIDATED'

UPDATE int_integration_task SET task_name = #{taskName}, enabled = #{enabled}, draft_revision_id = #{draftRevisionId}, config_version = config_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_code = #{taskCode} AND config_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE int_integration_task SET active_revision_id = #{activeRevisionId}, draft_revision_id = NULL, config_version = config_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_code = #{taskCode} AND config_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT task_code, task_name, task_type, enabled, active_revision_id, draft_revision_id, config_version FROM int_integration_task ORDER BY task_code
SELECT revision_id, task_code, revision_no, status, config_json, config_checksum, dependency_revisions_json FROM int_integration_task_revision WHERE task_code = #{taskCode} ORDER BY revision_no DESC
